narrative.headline: 2019 GMC Sierra 1500: engine and transmission lead the complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 595 complaints with NHTSA. The engine is by far the biggest concern at 45% of all reports, followed by the transmission/power train (21%) and the brakes (19%). The brake reports are the most safety-heavy, tied to 5 crashes and 3 injuries, and a handful of engine and electrical reports mention fires. Test-drive thoroughly and check service history before buying.

issues.title: Engine
issues.blurb: The single biggest issue: 268 reports (45% of all complaints). Linked to 3 fires, 2 crashes, and 1 injury. Watch for oil leaks, smoke, and sudden loss of power.

issues.title: Power Train
issues.blurb: 124 reports (21%), with 1 fire and 1 injury. Owners describe hard, jarring shifts at low speeds. Pay close attention to how it shifts on a test drive.
